name: Eighty Jewellers Limited
summary: Eighty Jewellers Ltd. is dedicated to the crafting and marketing of exquisite jewelry, featuring both precious and semi-precious gemstones. Their comprehensive product selection encompasses a wide variety of personal adornments, including rings, earrings, armlets, pendants, gajrahs, nose rings, bracelets, chains, necklaces, bangles, and watches, as well as numerous items specifically designed for wedding occasions. The company was founded on September 15, 2010, and its central operations are based in Raipur, India.
